body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-02-06 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we will see much healthier numbers in this division in the next year" Metric: Polymer segment revenue. Target: clear growth in FY26. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: FY26 polymer revenue INR 507 cr, record high, +11%. But far below the 25-30% guided three months later.
